spec_match.rationale: A '⚠ textStream() not supported; falling back to pipeThrough(TextDecoderStream)' banner shows on load, but the click handler clears it and streams via the fallback with no persistent label, so during and after a run the output again reads as textStream() (button label included).

interactive.rationale: Both buttons stream/read the real Blob payload with chunk counts and timing ('Done in 2.4ms (single read)').

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch is detected but its labelling does not survive interaction.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 0 pass / 4 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: streamed and single-read the payload; chunk log and timer updated; zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, but chunk-log/timer updates are unannounced.

openQuestions.title: Keep the fallback label visible during and after streaming
openQuestions.detail: The click handler does chunkLog.textContent = '' which erases the ⚠ fallback banner before streaming via TextDecoderStream (source lines 43-52); persist the fallback notice (separate element or prefix each run's log) so the run itself never masquerades as textStream().

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: both read modes worked with live chunk/timing readouts and zero console errors; the honest fallback banner exists on load but is cleared the moment 'Stream with textStream()' is clicked, leaving the fallback run unlabelled.
